episode.episode_title: Monzo's search for a middle ground
episode.episode_description: Monzo is reportedly in talks to sell a minority stake to private equity firms, signalling a shift in strategy after takeover discussions with Nubank stalled. We look at what this means for the bank's independence and its ambitious valuation.

selected_story.headline: Monzo eyes private equity stake sale
selected_story.source_title: Sources: UK neobank Monzo is in talks with CVC and Advent to sell up to a 15% stake, after Nubank takeover talks collapsed over the ~£10B valuation Monzo sought (Laith Al-Khalaf/Financial Times)

short.title: Monzo eyes private equity stake sale
short.description:
This follows the collapse of takeover talks with Nubank, suggesting Monzo is seeking growth capital while maintaining its independence at a high valuation.
